english:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Powered Melee Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy.

10|5|1 second cooldown between Orbs.

Can trigger alongside Firepower if equipped after it, counting mods from left to right.

source.text:
On Powered Melee Kill:
Spawns an Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.
Can trigger alongside Firepower if equipped after it.
From left to right order.
